import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

def test_worker_calls_run_job_and_uses_slots():
    job = {"id": 1}
    mock_slots = MagicMock()
    mock_slots.__enter__.return_value = None
    mock_slots.__exit__.return_value = None
    mock_run_job = MagicMock()

    with patch("__main__.SLOTS", mock_slots), patch("__main__.run_job", mock_run_job):
        _worker(job)

    mock_slots.__enter__.assert_called_once()
    mock_slots.__exit__.assert_called_once()
    mock_run_job.assert_called_once_with(job)


def test_worker_propagates_exception_and_exits_context():
    job = {"id": 2}
    mock_slots = MagicMock()
    mock_slots.__enter__.return_value = None
    mock_slots.__exit__.return_value = None

    def raise_error(_):
        raise ValueError("boom")

    with patch("__main__.SLOTS", mock_slots), patch("__main__.run_job", side_effect=raise_error):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            _worker(job)

    mock_slots.__enter__.assert_called_once()
    mock_slots.__exit__.assert_called_once()
